example-embed.name: Example Embed
example-embed.description: Minimal embed preset: 3D only, source panels hidden, Image Georeferencer hidden, hillshade + hypsometric tint on by default.

mapterhorn-globe.name: Mapterhorn Globe
mapterhorn-globe.description: Minimal globe view zoomed out to the whole world, Mapterhorn as the only terrain source, source pickers and Image Georeferencer hidden, GMT Globe hypsometric ramp.

dura.name: Dura Frescoes Viewer
dura.description: Dura Europos Synagogue COG terrain + basemap (W-0.5mm), fixed 2D view over the site, hillshade on (hypsometric tint off), raster basemap at 20% opacity, Relief Visualization and Terrain Analysis available but off, contours/mound-detector/split-screen/elevation-picker off and hidden, 2D/3D view modes only (no globe), sidebar closed by default, source pickers hidden, Visualization Modes and Hillshade Options sections open, map controls disabled, Bookmarks/Source-Info/Sun-Shadow-Calculator/Image-Georeferencer sections and the General Settings Project + Open-in controls hidden, light pinned to Free mode (no Free/Datetime selector), Shadows sub-mode off and hidden.
